reason: Holds as ops hygiene. It is not a score mechanism, so R1-R10/R8 and the byte-identical and fail-soft rules do not apply; it touches no kernel, submit or final. The failure mode is real. The CronCreate schema says jobs are session-only, `durable` has no effect, and jobs fire only while the REPL is idle. There is a precedent: the laptop froze and was power-cycled on 24 Sep at 11:37Z (CONTEXT l.1371). The RESUME POINT TIMERS line (l.2618) is already stale: it names 2f0d1fa1 and c7cd2e6b, but those were replaced by 2e87e414 (l.2747) and deleted (07:41Z). A resumed session would look for jobs that no longer exist. R11-A5 raised the 'timers die with the session' problem but produced no restore card, so the finding is new. Limits: value on score is 0. The finals are already ticked [#37, #38] and SELECTED cannot change without the user, so the tick checks and the 23:27Z snapshot are calibration and reminders, not a floor; the E10 v3 watch is the only row with score leverage. The proposed gate is wrong as written: 'CronList shows every id on the card' is trivially true in this session and impossible after a restore (CronCreate issues new ids). CronList at 11:13Z also shows three one-shots whose times have passed (5b23a3ed, 54a8f20d, cdd738f1), which the card should clean up.
fix: Put the card into R16-A6 with these corrections. (1) Key the rows by action and UTC time, not by id. Columns: action, UTC time, local cron (UTC+3), latest manual deadline, current id. Rows: E10 P1 recurring hh:04 UTC to 29 Sep 00:30Z, with the prompt checked against E10 v3 (trigger >= 0.955; the 2e87e414 prompt predates v3); tick checks 28 Sep 17:57Z, 29 Sep 11:57Z and 17:57Z (last manual deadline 19:45Z); final LB snapshot 29 Sep 23:27Z (cron '27 2 30 9 *'; manual window 23:00-23:45Z). (2) Gate: after any resume, and at the 28 Sep 17:57Z check, CronList has exactly one live job per card row with the same time and action. Past one-shots do not count. Delete 5b23a3ed, 54a8f20d and cdd738f1 once their checks are confirmed done. (3) Cron fires only while the REPL is idle, so the deadline column is binding. If a row's action is not logged by its deadline, the session does it by hand. (4) Poller row: liveness = last '=== ' header in poll.log < 15 min old (W6, l.2064); restart with Start-Process -WorkingDirectory <repo root> python experiments/lb_poll/lb_poll.py (l.2567); log PID and the gap. (5) Keep the user's own alarms as backup. The card is text only, about 10 minutes of work, and needs no new user OK.
realistic_gain: 0 on score. Guards the E10 v3 trigger watch (the only row with score leverage, P(trigger) small), the three tick reminders and the 23:27Z calibration snapshot against a session loss. I would put the loss chance by 29 Sep 23:30Z at ~5-15%, given the 24 Sep precedent and that sleep and auto-reboot are already off. It also fixes stale timer ids in the RESUME POINT.
